name: Mint & Garlic Lamb Chops
ingredients: 18-20 g fresh mint leaves and tender stalks, woody stems removed
1 tbsp lemon juice, plus zest of 1/2 lemon

steps.text: Put the fresh mint, garlic and rosemary into the mixing bowl and chop 5 sec / speed 7. Scrape down the sides.
Add the olive oil, honey, lemon juice, lemon zest, English mustard, flaky sea salt, MSG and black pepper. Mix 10 sec / speed 4.
Coat the lamb chops thoroughly in the marinade. Cover and refrigerate for 2-4 hours, or overnight for a stronger flavour.
Heat a barbecue for direct cooking to 230-250°C.
Cook the lamb chops over direct heat for 3-4 minutes per side, depending on thickness and preferred doneness.
Rest the lamb chops for 5-10 minutes before serving.
